xna-type.name: BoneWeight
xna-type.summary: Provides properties for managing a bone weight.
xna-type.remarks: A bone weight describes the influence of a single bone on the position of a vertex. These are grouped into BoneWeightCollection objects, which are stored in a vertex data channel.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of BoneWeight with the specified name and weight.

parameters.parameter: Amount of influence, ranging from zero to one.

property.name: BoneName
property.summary: Gets the name of the bone.
property.remarks: The bone can be located by searching for a BoneContent object with a matching Name property.

property.name: Weight
property.summary: Gets the amount of bone influence, ranging from zero to one. The complete set of weights in a BoneWeightCollection should sum to one.
